open prog 20
	abs
	linear
	f(gWs_RefVel) ta(0.1) ts(0)
	frax(c, x, y)

	//Laser & wobble off ///////////////////////
	M11 P0 //Laser off
	DWELL 0
	M21 // wobble off

	//Move to start pos. And Speed ///////////////////////
	gWs_RefVel=50
	f(gWs_RefVel) // Pos-init speed
	x2.500		y11.998		c(-0.000) // start pos
	dwell 0

	//Core Laswr ///////////////////////
	M12 W200//core power
	M13 D100 F100//core Duration and Frequency

	//Ring Laswr ///////////////////////
	M14 W200//ring power
	M15 D100 F100//ring Duration and Frequency

	//Wobble ///////////////////////
	M21// wobble off
	M20 A100 B100 D50 L200 T0 // wabble setting

	M10 P100		// Laser On

	frax(x, y)
sg
